title: The Gate of the Feral Gods
author: Matt Dinniman
summary: Book four in the series about a deadly alien game show staged inside the ruins of Earth. The stakes and the cast keep growing as the survivors face harsher floors and powerful, scheming game sponsors.
readIf: you want another installment of heavy-hitting dungeon action with a surprisingly big heart.
skipIf: you are new to the series, since the story and in-jokes depend on the earlier books.

pairings.reason: Both pit characters against a vicious, hierarchical system with big set-piece battles and betrayals.
Shares the engineering-style problem-solving and an odd, loveable team dynamic, though far gentler.
Another long fantasy series of grim humour and hard-bitten soldiers who stick together.
